content.short: Trading since 2014, Poloniex offers spot, margin and futures on hundreds of tokens, including many smaller ones.
content.description: Poloniex was among the first exchanges to list a wide range of altcoins, and it still carries a long list of smaller tokens next to BTC, ETH and TRX. Users can trade spot pairs, use margin or open futures positions. It belongs to the companies linked to Justin Sun, so it works closely with the TRON ecosystem. It now includes trading bots, futures copy trading, SmartEarn interest on futures balances, a LaunchBase token sale platform and a direct link to SunSwap for TRON DeFi.
content.meta: Exchange running since 2014 with spot, margin and futures on a long list of altcoins. Explore Poloniex on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
